title: Choose the visual world
question: Keep the systems atlas, take an alternate, or re-roll with a steer.

options.label: Surveyor's Systems Atlas
options.lineage: field-survey charts, systems maps, and working atlases
options.thesis: A builder makes difficult territory legible, then opens vivid windows into what was found there.
options.viewport: A bright mapped field fills the screen: Mathieu's name anchors one edge while precise routes connect a few large art plates and explicit portals into Work, Writing, Bookshelf, and About.
options.risk: The cartographic grammar becomes cold or over-labelled if the artwork does not periodically take over at full scale.
options.case: Strongest balance: technical leaders recognize the act of making complexity legible, while the atlas keeps every content area immediately navigable.

options.label: Daylight Section
options.thesis: A personal world revealed as one continuous section, with strong ideas moving through it like sunlight.
options.viewport: A long cutaway studio crosses the page; Work, Writing, Bookshelf, and About occupy distinct rooms while a gold beam isolates the current narrative event.
options.risk: The architecture metaphor may imply literal building design and make Mathieu's varied imagery feel like material pinned inside someone else's system.
options.case: Fuses strongly on clarity and precision, but identifies Mathieu slightly less accurately than the atlas because the architectural metaphor is unusually literal.

options.label: Multiplane Storyworld
options.thesis: Work and ideas occupy painted depths, and moving through the site changes which layer comes into focus.
options.viewport: A daylight composition uses several restrained image planes; Mathieu's identity sits crisply above them while focus reveals the first path into his work.
options.risk: The cinematic depth can become storybook-like, obscure dense information, or make every transition feel equally dramatic.
options.case: Best emotional fusion with the artwork, but weaker than the atlas on executive orientation and dense reading surfaces.

options.label: Registered Color Plates
options.thesis: A person becomes visible one precisely registered layer at a time: systems, products, writing, reading, and images.
options.viewport: A clean keyline establishes Mathieu and the four portals; selected color plates register into place as the first artwork completes the sheet.
options.risk: The fixed print grammar competes with the varied image corpus and risks borrowing a culturally specific aesthetic as decoration.
options.case: The layered-craft metaphor is clear, but it fuses poorly because it would force unrelated artworks into one woodblock treatment.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A restrained introduction, selected work, recent writing, and a quiet personal layer arranged in a familiar editorial grid.
canonCard.viewport: Mathieu's name and short introduction lead beside one artwork, followed immediately by selected work and recent writing.
canonCard.risk: Highly legible and credible, but unlikely to make the personal world or interactive ambition memorable.
